shots.action: Ocean swells and rain move independently. Ground-level light alternates between the red land and blue sea. Slow track towards the conflict.
Groudon raises a claw and roars; Kyogre rises with a breaking wave. Actual character poses and water motion, not a zoom over a still.
Cloud layers uncover a close-up. Rayquaza opens his eye; emerald reflections travel over scales. A held moment before the reveal.
Rayquaza uncoils and flies through the opening. Articulated long body and fins, clouds pushed aside, moving light shaft.
Rayquaza opens his jaw and roars. Groudon recoils, Kyogre sinks, waves and rain are pushed outwards in a visible shockwave.
The ocean settles, clouds part and the coiled dragon holds a majestic pose over the bay. Return directly to the reward UI.

qualityGate: Animated bodies, jaws, fins, water and cloud layers
Custom poses rather than reused combat sprites
Pixel clusters remain coherent; no painted-to-realistic drift
No stretch, morphing anatomy, duplicate heads or disappearing fins
Six animated shots with causal transitions
Normal and shiny versions are separate media files
Reviewed full playback at desktop and mobile sizes
